title: A Unifying Relational Perspective on Expressive Lottery Tickets
abstract: arXiv:2608.18819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used, but how parameter sparsity affects the expressivity of relational (RGNNs) and temporal (TGNNs) variants is poorly understood. The Strong Expressive Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (SELTH) posits the existence of sparse GNNs that preserve Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) expressivity on static graphs. We generalize this existence result to a probabilistic statement for multi-relational and temporal domains via the relational WL (RWL). We prove that sufficiently parameterized RGNNs contain sparse subnetworks that maintain 1-RWL expressivity and derive a lower bound on the probability that a random pruning yields such a subnetwork. We show that common TGNNs and cross-graph message passing schemes admit RGNN reformulations such that they inherit these guarantees and, moreover, that the expressivity of a sparse RGNN is connected to its optimization behavior under common update regimes. translated_title: 表达性彩票的统一关系视角
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNNs）被广泛使用，但参数稀疏性如何影响关系型（RGNNs）和时序型（TGNNs）变体的表达性仍知之甚少。强表达性彩票假设（SELTH）认为存在稀疏GNN，能在静态图上保持Weisfeiler-Leman（WL）表达性。我们将这一存在性结果推广到多关系和时序领域的概率性陈述，通过关系WL（RWL）实现。我们证明了参数充足的RGNNs包含保持1-RWL表达性的稀疏子网络，并推导了随机剪枝产生此类子网络的概率下界。我们展示了常见的TGNNs和跨图消息传递方案可重新表述为RGNNs，从而继承这些保证，此外，稀疏RGNN的表达性与其在常见更新机制下的优化行为相关。实验验证了这一理论。
tldr: 该论文将表达性彩票假设推广到关系和时序图网络，证明稀疏子网络能保持关系WL表达性，并揭示了其与优化行为的关联。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes the expressive lottery ticket hypothesis to relational and temporal graph networks, proving that sparse subnetworks preserve relational WL expressivity and linking it to optimization behavior.
